confidence_notes: Restaurant and café anchors rest on several converging crowd-sourced guides (Numbeo, Citiesinsider) and Expatistan listings, some dated 2024 or older. Beer and cocktail come from thin Expatistan and bar-listing data, and wine_glass is inferred from the beer anchor, not from direct price data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no live listings or booking pages checked. CNY-to-USD conversion assumes about 7.1 CNY per USD, which was not searched. The FX observation is taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not checked against the full RBA table, so the 16 October 2026 value should be verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Chinese provincial-capital pricing, benchmarked against Nanjing listings and nearby Chinese cities such as Shanghai and Hangzhou, with restaurant anchors set at Nanjing levels. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for registered Chinese hostels and hotels in a mid-sized provincial capital.
